description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContactService class, which provides methods for managing employee emergency contacts, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and searching of emergency contact records within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee emergency contacts, acting as an intermediary between the data access layer and higher-level application logic.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the EmpEmergencyContactDao instance used for data operations.

methods.name: setEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Sets the EmpEmergencyContactDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for an employee based on employee number and contact sequence number.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all emergency contacts for a specific employee.

methods.name: saveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves a new or existing employee emergency contact record.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes specified emergency contacts for an employee; if no sequence numbers are provided, deletes all contacts for the employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Searches for employee emergency contacts matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of emergency contacts matching search filter parameters.
